Template for tile unit test setup, link initialization, callback updates, and test loop execution.

# Purpose
This file defines a C test template for tile execution in the `fd` framework. It is not a standalone program or a normal library file. It is meant to be included after the caller defines template macros such as `TEST_TILE_CTX_TYPE`, `FD_TILE_TEST_LINKS_OUT_CNT`, and `FD_TILE_TEST_LINKS_CNT`. The code builds a test harness that drives a tile through repeated loop iterations, selects input and output links, and invokes callback hooks around credit checks and fragment processing.

The main parts of the file are the `fd_tile_test_callbacks_t` and `fd_tile_test_frag_params_t` types, the [`fd_tile_test_reset_env`](<#fd_tile_test_reset_env>), [`fd_tile_test_init_link_in`](<#fd_tile_test_init_link_in>), and [`fd_tile_test_init_link_out`](<#fd_tile_test_init_link_out>) setup functions, and the [`fd_tile_test_run`](<#fd_tile_test_run>) loop. The setup code initializes test links from topology data, resets sequence state, and stores callback functions for input and output verification. The run code selects an upstream producer, updates fragment state, calls tile callbacks such as `TEST_CALLBACK_BEFORE_CREDIT`, `TEST_CALLBACK_AFTER_CREDIT`, `TEST_CALLBACK_BEFORE_FRAG`, `TEST_CALLBACK_DURING_FRAG`, and `TEST_CALLBACK_AFTER_FRAG`, and checks output links with verifier functions. This file provides the common control flow for tile tests and exposes a template-based interface for different tile context types and callback sets.
